notes.title: SENRAN KAGURA Peach Beach Splash Ver. 1.08 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
We have just released Ver. 1.08 of SENRAN KAGURA Peach Beach Splash.
This update addresses the following issues:

- Fixed issue for VR Diorama where models will return to default position
- Fixed graphical issue where the background and model will reflect image when firing a weapon
- Made the camera control with the mouse much smoother

We have received reports of the mouse stuttering or moving the character without input for some users, but we have been unable to reproduce this. If you are experiencing this issue, please send us detailed information at support@xseedgames.com

If you are experiencing discomfort because of the smooth camera in VR mode, we recommend changing the "Turn Camera" setting to "Fixed Angle Rotation" in the Settings menu, under the "VR" tab.

notes.title: SENRAN KAGURA Peach Beach Splash Ver. 1.07 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
We have just released Ver. 1.07.
This patch adds several new features. We hope you enjoy them!

Ver. 1.07 Updates
-Adds a new VR Mode to the dressing room. To access this mode, connect your VR headset and select "Launch SENRAN KAGURA Peach Beach Splash in Steam VR Mode". You can interact with individual characters in the Character Viewer Mode or create elaborate dioramas in Diorama Viewer mode. This version introduces new camera options. Try them out to find the best way to interact with the characters in VR.
-[b]Valve Anti-Cheat functionality has now been enabled for this title.[/b] Users found to be employing cheat applications might be banned.

The Sunshine Edition DLC outfits are also now on sale!

notes.title: SENRAN KAGURA Peach Beach Splash Ver. 1.06 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
We have just released Ver. 1.06. This patch addresses various quality of life issues and adds requested features.

Ver. 1.06 Updates
-Adds dynamic button prompts for Keyboard & Mouse and Playstation input.
-Borderless window mode now works for all resolutions
-Adds a further fix to stabilitize multiplayer matches
-Adds an authenticity check to multiplayer

notes.title: SENRAN KAGURA Peach Beach Splash Ver. 1.05 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
We have just released Ver. 1.05. This patch addresses instability in the multiplayer lobby and two control issues.

We appreciate your patience as we worked to isolate the cause of the multiplayer crash. Thank you to everyone who submitted dmp files and other detailed information.

Ver. 1.05 Updates
-Fixes a crash that could occur when viewing ally information on the multiplayer lobby screen.
-Adds an option to view opponent information during a match. The default is Q or Back/Share. Players with Q already mapped to a function may have to temporarily reset their custom controls, but Q can be mapped to any function. We apologize for any inconvenience that this causes.
-Camera controls in dressing room now reflect global "Normal/Reverse" settings.

Issues that we are still looking into:
-Implementing button prompts for Keyboard & Mouse and PlayStation controllers
-Borderless window mode not functioning as intended

Please use the official bug report thread to let us know if you encounter any bugs or if there are features you would like us to implement.

notes.title: SENRAN KAGURA Peach Beach Splash Ver. 1.04 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
We have just released Ver. 1.04. This patch addresses two crashes and a bug preventing Q and Left Ctrl from being reassigned.

We have received dozens of dmp files from multiplayer crashes. Thank you to those who have sent these to us as they are a valuable resource. We are continuing to work on multiplayer lobby instability, and we hope to have an update soon.

If you are having trouble finding players for ranked matches, please try searching in Global multiplayer as well.

Ver. 1.04 Updates
-Fixed crash caused by using Sexy Soaker LE cards while playing in French
-Fixed crash occurring late in story mode
-Q and Left Ctrl are now usable in main gameplay. Q (camera reset) cannot be remapped for the Dressing Room, however.

Issues that we are still looking into:
-Stabilizing multiplayer lobby, including a crash that occurs when viewing ally information
-Implementing button prompts for Keyboard & Mouse and PlayStation controllers
-Borderless window mode not functioning as intended

Please use the official bug report thread to let us know if you encounter any bugs or if there are features you would like us to implement.

notes.title: SENRAN KAGURA Peach Beach Splash Ver. 1.03 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone!

We have just released Ver. 1.03. We apologize for the longer delay between updates. 

Unfortunately, this patch does not include a fix for the multiplayer lobby crash. We are still working on this and appreciate the information and crash reports that you have sent.

Ver. 1.03 Updates
-Fixes issue causing abnormally high CPU usage for some users
-Adds player and camera movement to Keyboard & Mouse configuration menu. Fixes a bug where reassigned buttons would not swap.
-Fixes issue causing sound to drop in the middle of matches
-Fixes issue where the camera would rotate automatically in borderless window mode when using an XBOX controller

Issues that we are still looking into:
-Stabilizing multiplayer lobby, including a crash that occurs when viewing ally information
-Implementing button prompts for Keyboard & Mouse and PlayStation controllers
-Borderless window mode not functioning as intended
-Crashes occurring late in story mode

Please use the official bug report thread to let us know if you encounter any bugs or if there are features you would like us to implement.

notes.title: SENRAN KAGURA Peach Beach Splash Ver. 1.02 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone!

We have just released Ver. 1.02.

We know that many of you are experiencing crashes in the multiplayer lobby. We are working to stabilize the lobby for all users.

Ver. 1.02 Updates
-Fixes soft lock that occurred when trying to equip Sparkling Rainbow Bikini color variations 6 or 7
-Made adjustments to the accessories to further stablize crash issue fixed in Ver. 1.01
-Pressing the F key no longer causes the camera to rotate freely
-Custom keyboard control assignments will no longer revert to the default
-Made overall changes to the multiplayer matching to improve stability in the lobby

Issues that we are still working on:
-Implementing button prompts for Keyboard & Mouse and PlayStation controllers
-Abnormally high CPU usage for some users
-Borderless window mode not functioning as intended

We really appreciate your patience. Please use the official bug report thread to let us know if you encounter any bugs or if there are features you would like us to implement.
